meta.product: GoalIQ SPL Fantasy Phase 0 - clean sheet % + model FDR
meta.team_strength_source: GoalIQ Dixon-Coles, SPL results (ESPN) ['2425', '2526', '2627'] incl. 36 played 26/27 matches from the RSL Fantasy feed - goals-based fit (decay=0.0035, bayes=2.0); no free per-match xG feed exists for the SPL
meta.cs_method: P(opponent scores 0) from the DC score matrix (tau corrected)
meta.fdr_method: Model based 1-5: 0.55*rank(1 - win%) + 0.45*rank(expected goals conceded), quintile bucket across every team fixture of the season
meta.att_fdr_method: Attack FDR 1-5: rank(own expected xG in the fixture) inverted (little xG of your own means a hard fixture), quintile bucket across every team fixture. 1 = easiest to attack against, 5 = hardest.
meta.caveat: Team strengths are fitted on the last two seasons plus the 36 matches of 26/27 played so far (goals-based, no xG data for the SPL). Promoted sides blend from a measured promoted baseline toward their fitted strength as real matches accumulate (full weight at 6). No manual context layer (unlike FPL Phase 1b).
meta.far_basis_label: Fixture difficulty only, based on today's ratings. Clean sheet % appears as each gameweek moves closer.

snapshot.note: Last build published before the round kicked off (first GW1 kickoff 13 Aug 2026, 16:15 UTC). Fitted on vendored history ending 21 May 2026, with no 26/27 results in the fit.

gw_reconciliation.naive_note: Constant probability equal to the clean sheet share in the same two-season history the model is fitted on.
